dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Shh, you have to keep your voice down here.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: If there's anything you want to buy, just go ahead and take it, then leave the money to one side.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to use the Crafting Bench.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Feel free to use it if no one else is. No need to ask me first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling?

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: See these, and... these? It's all here, so if anything's missing, it means we're out of stock.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of effect would there be if I speak too loud?

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: That's a very good question.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Many people overlook environmental factors when they're making things, so the fact that you even thought of asking shows that you're well ahead of the game.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: They all know that the amount of Spinel Fruit Powder you put in changes a potion's effect, and that drawing a talisman with an extra line can end up producing a completely different result.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: So why don't they seem to understand that sound too can have an effect when crafting materials?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you afraid of losing stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Ah, you might be asking the wrong question there, friend.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: As soon as the idea of profiting from another's labor gets mentioned, even if we're talking about a morally upstanding individual, it's hard to prevent a bad seed from being planted.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: But no matter. Anyway, we're just talking about a few odds and ends that the Mol Stone House sells on commission.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Even if one or two items go missing, all I have to do is draw a couple of prayer talismans and I'll have made my money back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Take care now, and step lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I get where you're coming from, but our surroundings aren't quiet either...

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: ...Ah, well naturally, that's something that I've already taken into consideration!

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: I base everything I do here on my existing environment.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: In the past, as people have come and gone, so too have a variety of different stories. These... Yes, these are also part of the production process.

dialogues.speaker: Bounama
dialogues.text: As we Masters of the Night-Wind say: "All has been understood, and the future becomes the past."
